dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.search.use-public-pattern-factory>
<!description: Replace internal PatternConstructor.createPattern with public TextSearchEngine.createPattern when fixed parameters match the public API's implicit values.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.search.internal.core.text.PatternConstructor.createPattern($pattern, $isRegex, true, $isCaseSensitive, false)
=>
org.eclipse.search.core.text.TextSearchEngine.createPattern($pattern, $isCaseSensitive, $isRegex)
;;
summary: Replace internal PatternConstructor.createPattern with TextSearchEngine.createPattern for fixed parameter calls.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
